name: browser_extension
description: This Manifest V3 extension provides real-time browser monitoring for the FocusEcho Web app. It observes active tab changes and navigation, compares hosts only against the user-configured distracting-site list, and sends live events to the open FocusEcho tab.

scripts.test:all: node tests/check-manifest.js && node tests/state-machine.test.js && node tests/database-sync.test.js && node tests/parking-lot.test.js && node tests/replay-real-use.mjs
